---
title: "Research Projects"
listing:
  contents: projects                  # Path to folder or list of files (e.g., "projects/*.qmd")
  type: grid                          # Renders as a card grid
  grid-columns: 3                     # Number of grid columns (1 to 6)
  image-height: "200px"               # Fixes uniform height for images
  grid-item-border: true              # Adds card borders (optional)
  fields: [image, title, description] # Elements displayed on each grid card
  sort: "title asc"                   # Sorting order
---
